day_summary: ORD's 2026-07-22 local scheduled-operation cohort contains 2,142 reporting-carrier domestic segments: 1,071 departures and 1,071 arrivals. The realized record includes 24 cancellations, 1 diversions, and 459 ORD endpoint delays of at least 15 minutes. Archived KORD METAR observations for the same local day remain available in weather.csv.

replay_window.flight_selection: Departures use Origin == ORD and BTS FlightDate == 2026-07-22. Arrivals use Dest == ORD and a resolved scheduled ORD arrival date of 2026-07-22, including prior-origin-date overnight flights and excluding flights scheduled to reach ORD on 2026-07-23.
replay_window.arrival_date_derivation: BTS does not publish a scheduled arrival date. The builder solves scheduled elapsed minutes = arrival clock - departure clock + day offset - (ORD UTC offset - origin UTC offset) against the valid U.S. domestic offset differences [-60, 0, 60, 120, 180, 240, 300] minutes. Every inbound candidate must produce exactly one day offset.

schedule.rule: Only the allowlisted columns in schedule.csv may be loaded before a prediction or recommendation. Tail identity and every realized outcome are excluded.

weather.rule: Reveal an observation only when the replay clock is greater than or equal to observed_at_local.

ground_truth.rule: Never expose ground_truth.csv to an agent before its prediction or recommendation is persisted. Delay causes are post-event labels.
known_absences: counterfactual outcome under an alternative action

sources.scope: July 2026 reporting-carrier domestic nonstop flight records

sources.publisher: Iowa Environmental Mesonet, Iowa State University
sources.scope: KORD routine and special METAR observations requested in local time

coverage_notes: BTS covers reportable U.S. domestic nonstop operations, not every ORD movement.
FlightDate is the scheduled origin service date; the builder resolves the ORD scheduled arrival date and requires a unique valid offset solution.
IEM distributes the archived observations as-is and notes that only limited quality control is applied.
A historical replay can score predictions against realized outcomes but cannot observe the outcome of an action that was not taken.

benchmark_cohort.name: ORD July 2026 full evaluable day cohort
benchmark_cohort.selection_rule: Every July 2-31, 2026 local day. July 1 is excluded because its prior-day overnight arrivals require prior-month source rows.
